records.affected_users_text: Fewer than 0.1% potentially affected under the combined seed-phrase activation and in-app support contact within seven days conditions
records.description: Tangem disclosed that when a wallet was activated with a generated or imported seed phrase, a bug in the mobile app's NFC logging mechanism could write the private key into app logs. Potential exposure required the user to also contact Tangem support through the app within seven days, allowing those logs to be included with the support interaction.
records.notes: Tangem states that no private keys were compromised, no funds were lost, and no unauthorized account access occurred. Seedless activation was not affected by this bug, and users who did not contact support through the app during the seven-day log-retention window were not affected. WLR therefore records funds_affected=no while retaining the material key-exposure risk of the logging defect. No affected-version start or range is inferred.
records.title: Tangem App logging bug could include private-key material in diagnostic logs

records.description: Tangem's official security changelog records a December 27, 2024 security/bugfix release that fixed the mobile-app logging bug for the same seed-phrase plus in-app-support condition.
records.notes: The fixed-release date is taken from Tangem's first-party security changelog. No affected-version start or range is recorded because the reviewed first-party sources do not establish one.
records.title: Tangem released iOS 5.19.1 and Android 5.19.2 to fix mobile-app log exposure
